mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 38 degrees with clear skies near the Verona Area High School. We are currently under a Waxing Crescent moon, and you can catch the ISS passing overhead tonight at 6:32 PM, moving from the West near Mount Horeb toward Madison, reaching about halfway up the sky.

The City of Verona is currently managing several development projects, including a site plan and traffic analysis for Sub-Zero at Liberty Business Park, while Municipal Court continues to process traffic and ordinance citations.

There is plenty to do with the Dane County Farmers Market and live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's happening today, plus the John Denver tribute concert coming up tomorrow at the Verona Area High School Fine Arts Center.
In our weekly police report, on October 25 at 5:34 AM, officers located a 40-year-old Verona man passed out behind the wheel at Plympton Street and Rita Avenue, resulting in an arrest for an O W I.
Stop by Culver's today to enjoy the Caramel Cashew flavor of the day; they are open now and will remain open until 10:30 PM.
